dependency_snapshot.workspace_note: The final control and candidate release artifacts were rebuilt against these exact live lower-layer revisions. Hypermesh was deliberately left out of scope.

semantic_evidence.authoritative_route: CurveRegion2 Boolean and unary regularization continue through one CurveRegionBooleanContext arrangement. No second Boolean, offset, fillet, or chamfer engine was added.
semantic_evidence.chord_parameter: BezierAlgebraicChordParameter2 represents either endpoint without allocation and represents a true interior point by shared exact algebraic evidence. Its exact axis/order comparison drives event ordering and split ranges.
semantic_evidence.native_lowering: A retained algebraic chord with exact endpoints lowers directly to the native line carrier; it is not materialized as a synthetic Bezier parameter interval.
semantic_evidence.source_related_contact: For a one-field chord/source pair, the exact homogeneous line-incidence polynomial is formed over the selected source field. Hypersolve deflates the authored diagonal endpoint root, counts residual closed-domain roots, isolates every residual source parameter, replays exact image incidence, and constructs the tangent-cross sign.
semantic_evidence.positive_dimensional_gate: An identically zero or otherwise positive-dimensional source/chord incidence remains an explicit typed blocker. It is never sampled or treated as disjoint.
semantic_evidence.retained_range_winding: Boundary-side and ray classification retain the original source parameter field and range. Exact bivariate ray incidence, Bernstein/local-field exclusion, selected-fiber isolation, range clipping, ahead-of-ray ordering, derivative parity, traversal reversal, and projective denominator signs decide the winding contribution.
semantic_evidence.multiplicity: The first nonzero parameter derivative decides crossing parity, so simple, even, and higher odd contacts take distinct exact paths.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT uses only proof-producing field identities, exact polynomial arithmetic, isolated-root order, Sturm counts, exact signs, and certified topology. Unproved paths remain explicit errors.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 executes the same arrangement and algebraic graph. Every Hypersolve approximate certainty used by this route is observed by Hypercurve, and the only permitted approximation is the shared 512-bit terminal equality decision.

historical_behavior.residual_source_contact: The one-field chord/source proof completed only when diagonal-root deflation proved a residual root count of zero. Any residual contact was Unsupported.
historical_behavior.interior_chord_event: Any interior chord split parameter was rejected because no authoritative algebraic chord-local parameter existed.
historical_behavior.retained_range_winding: An algebraic point could not obtain a winding contribution from a retained algebraic source range.
